body.heading: Where in the world is Guatemala?
paragraphs: Guatemala is a country in Central America, which is part of North America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Guatemala is Guatemala City.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Guatemala is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Guatemala is the Guatemalan quetzal.

body.heading: How big is Guatemala?
paragraphs: Guatemala covers about 109,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Costa Rica.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Tikal's Maya pyramids spear out of the jungle canopy, with howler monkeys and toucans for company — one of the great ancient cities of the Americas.
Lake Atitlán fills a volcanic crater ringed by villages, and nearby Antigua is a cobbled colonial gem beneath three volcanoes.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
